name: Investor Residence Card

requirements.blocker_text: The Carte de Sejour -- Investisseur targets foreigners establishing an enterprise in Burkina Faso, with investment minimums beginning around XOF 50 million (roughly EUR 76,000); larger ventures in mining or agribusiness reportedly require XOF 200-500 million. The 2018 Investment Code provides tax exemptions of up to 5 years for strategic sectors.
requirements.fix_path: Establish a qualifying enterprise with at least XOF 50 million in investment capital and apply for the Investor Residence Card.

sources.title: Openshores (private immigration-guide site) -- Carte de Sejour categories including the Investisseur route, investment thresholds, and the 2018 Investment Code's tax-exemption regime
